intro: A UK visit visa (Standard Visitor visa) covers tourism, visiting family and friends, and business trips. If you’re inviting someone, we help prepare both their application and your invitation documents.
cardText: Family visits, tourism and business trips to the UK.

checklist.item: A genuine reason for the visit

checklist.hint: Or a sponsor who can pay

purposesTitle: What a UK visit visa covers
notCovered: Not enough evidence of ties to home
A vague or inconsistent travel plan
Previous overstays or refusals not explained

documentsTable.details: Current passport and previous travel history.
Employment letter, business, study or property evidence.
From the host in the UK, with their status documents.

rules.title: Visa or ETA?
rules.text: Visitors from many countries, including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria and Ghana, need a visit visa. Visa-free visitors, such as US, Canadian, Australian and EU citizens, need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) instead.

rules.title: No work
rules.text: Visitors can’t work in the UK or access public funds.

rules.title: The host’s role
rules.text: A clear invitation letter, with the host’s own documents, makes a real difference.

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: UK visit visa: what the Home Office looks for
sections.text: The application should show a clear reason for the visit and a realistic plan, enough money to pay for the trip or a sponsor who can, strong reasons to return home, and a good immigration history.

sections.heading: Inviting family to the UK
sections.text: If you’re inviting parents or relatives, we prepare a clear invitation letter, gather your documents and check the visitor’s evidence, so the officer sees a consistent picture.

faqs.q: How long can I stay on a UK visit visa?
faqs.a: Usually up to 6 months per visit.

faqs.q: Can I work on a UK visit visa?
faqs.a: No. Visitors can’t work in the UK.

faqs.q: Can a family member sponsor my visit?
faqs.a: Yes. A host can provide an invitation and, if they’re paying, their financial evidence.
